verdict.rationale: Clara documents attaching labels (GL codes, cost centers, project IDs) to transactions and a reconciliation guide that pulls billing-period transactions, categorizes them with labels and exports them to accounting. Catching later updates and analyzing spend by category are also supported, and the marketing site claims automated expense reporting. However, the documented coding is a period-end, API-driven step rather than coding at the moment of spend, and receipts and memos are never mentioned. Missing for 10: automatic coding at point of spend, receipt capture/attachment, cardholder memo fields, merchant-to-category auto-mapping rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
